inventory.license: No explicit repository license was found in the inspected snapshot. This index contains only factual names and URLs; it does not include portfolio code, descriptions or images, or grant rights to those materials.

mapping.author: Forma
mapping.method: All listings in the pinned README are indexed without merging records by name. Three Forma-authored investigation guides provide questions for the collection, not findings about individual sites. Original URLs and source lines are retained; malformed URLs are quarantined instead of repaired. The feed is compared with the README to identify differences and is not authoritative.
limits: No portfolio website was visited, captured, tested or rated during this import. Availability, design, technology and ownership are unverified.
All cases contain investigation prompts shared by the collection, not extracted website features, professional classifications or quality endorsements.
The source declares no explicit license in this snapshot. This factual index does not authorize reuse of portfolio code, identities, text, fonts or images.
A malformed original URL remains visible as data with no active destination link. Historical feed-only URLs are recorded in portfolio-import.json, not silently substituted.
There is no automatic refresh or crawler. Inspect a selected site before using it as current design evidence.

cases.name: Developer portfolio: identity and contact
cases.whenToUse: Investigate how a developer presents their work, intended audience and contact options. Inclusion in this listing does not verify a profession, technology stack or level of design quality.
questions: Can a visitor understand the intended work and audience from real content?
Which contact and profile links are available and still work?
adapt: Write an introduction using the project owner's actual experience and goals.
Use the project's brand, typography and contact information; do not copy another person's identity or claims.
verify: Check heading hierarchy, text contrast, focus, long names and narrow-screen wrapping.
Verify contact links and distinguish a working form from an email link or a demonstration.

cases.name: Developer portfolio: project evidence and case studies
cases.whenToUse: Investigate how projects explain the problem, contribution and result. The index does not verify the claims made by each portfolio.
questions: Does a project distinguish individual contributions, team contributions and proposals?
Are demos, repositories, images and measured results identified as different kinds of evidence?
adapt: Build case studies from the owner's verifiable work, clearly describing the problem, role, decisions and result.
Choose media with known provenance and a readable text alternative; inspect any source-code license separately.
verify: Test project detail views and return navigation with real content, broken media and long titles.
Check that screenshots, links and results support the stated contribution without invented metrics.

cases.name: Developer portfolio: browsing and responsive navigation
cases.whenToUse: Investigate project selection, reading order, navigation and responsive behavior. Motion or 3D must be observed before assigning those characteristics to a site.
questions: Can visitors find and compare projects without opening every item?
What happens to focus, scroll position and selection when opening a project and returning?
adapt: Organize real projects using stable IDs and a coherent content hierarchy.
Choose the layout and interactions to support the task in the target project; keep animations optional and essential content accessible.
verify: Test keyboard and touch input, back navigation, narrow viewports and reduced motion on the selected reference and the resulting implementation.
Check empty lists, unavailable links, missing thumbnails and preserved reading context.
